---
title: Astro Elements
description: Server-side components library.
---

Rimelight UI includes a rich set of native Astro components that are compiled fully server-side for zero client-side JavaScript overhead.

## Key Components

- **RLAButton**: Configurable button with variants and icon support.
- **RLAInput**: Standard text input field.
- **RLASearch**: Site search overlay integration.
- **RLAShortcuts**: Global cheatsheet overlay for hotkeys.
